verdict.rationale: Compliance tooling is a fair question for a regulated banking platform, but the evidence pack never mentions transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, alert case management, SAR-filing support, or any split of compliance duties between customer, platform, and bank. Adjacent features such as VerifiedAccounts (account and tax-ID ownership checks), BoletoHolmes (boleto investigation), and payment approval flows are related controls, not the compliance workload this story describes, so they earn no credit.
